svg.title: CONFIRM trial outcomes per 100 people
svg.desc: Verified hepatorenal syndrome reversal occurred in 32 of 100 people with terlipressin and 17 of 100 with placebo. By day 90, 11 of 100 and 2 of 100, respectively, died of respiratory disorders. Overall survival was not improved.

g.text: 15 more per 100 — about 1 extra reversal for every 7 treated
Died of respiratory disorders by day 90
9 more per 100 — about 1 extra respiratory death for every 11 treated
CONFIRM trial, 300 adults with historical type 1 HRS. Survival was not improved.
